messages:
nina: quick follow-up after the smoke runs. two slips: fused-op wheels failing at dispatch and a perf cliff for long documents.

oscar: fused-op issue = wheel claims aten::fused_attn but runtime image only has unfused. fallback uses huge temps and OOMs.

li: we only check shapes/ABI today. propose we emit an op-list during wheel build and persist as metadata key `inferred_ops`. validator compares against image capability index.

nina: infra should publish image capabilities (ops, quant schemes, fused/unfused support) as an API; validator queries that instead of spinning containers.

infra-bot: INFRA-918 logged: add /v1/images/{tag}/capabilities export.

oscar: for op extraction, add `ops_inferred:true|false` and allow `required_ops` override in manifest for manual fixes. validator warns when inferred only.

li: for long-doc perf, add a lightweight `longtail` probe suite (5-10 canonical long prompts + seeded variants) and store `probe_suite` + `probe_hashes` in registry.

nina: cost tradeoff: microbench fast admit, schedule longtail async, block full production until pass but allow canary. record pass policy (e.g., 3-of-5) in admission ticket.

oscar: UX: rejection must include missing ops, confidence, and remediation steps (rebuild with unfused ops, request image bump, or pin alternate variant). include link to docs.

li: owners: nina -> probe suite & registry fields, oscar -> op-list extractor & manifest schema, infra -> capability API.

nina: i'll sketch the probe-suite PR today and add short author README.

oscar: i'll prototype op-list extractor tomorrow.

infra-bot: scheduled follow-up in Friday RFC meeting.
